mapper.select: SELECT * FROM advanced_guard WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,role,enabled FROM app_user WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM registration_request WHERE patient_id=#{patientId} AND request_key=#{key}
SELECT * FROM registration_request WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM registration_request WHERE status IN ('QUEUED','RETRY','PROCESSING')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM registration_request WHERE patient_id=#{patientId} AND created_at >= #{since}
mapper.update: UPDATE registration_request SET status='EXPIRED',error_code='QUEUE_EXPIRED',error_message='排队请求已超时，请重新选择排班',updated_at=#{now} WHERE status IN ('QUEUED','RETRY') AND expires_at <= #{now}
mapper.select: SELECT d.*,u.enabled user_enabled,dep.enabled department_enabled FROM doctor d JOIN app_user u ON u.id=d.user_id JOIN department dep ON dep.id=d.department_id WHERE d.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM schedule_template WHERE enabled=TRUE ORDER BY doctor_id,id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schedule WHERE doctor_id=#{doctor_id} AND work_date=#{work_date} AND period=#{period}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schedule WHERE doctor_id=#{doctor_id} AND start_time < #{end_time} AND end_time > #{start_time}
SELECT * FROM job_execution_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
